description: This file defines the interface 'NotesRepository', which specifies the contract for managing notes data, including observing, creating, updating, deleting, and syncing notes within the application.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for observing, managing, and synchronizing notes.

methods.name: observeNotes
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits a list of notes matching the specified query.

methods.name: observeNote
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits a single note identified by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with the given title and content; returns the ID of the created note.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates the note identified by ID with the new title and content.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the note identified by ID.

methods.name: syncNow
methods.description: Initiates a low-level synchronization process, intended for background workers.

methods.name: triggerManualSync
methods.description: Triggers a manual synchronization, typically invoked from the UI.

methods.name: observeSyncStatus
methods.description: Provides an observable StateFlow that indicates the current synchronization status for UI components.
